title: Pure Dinomist
summary: Pure Dinomist WATER Machine Pendulum build with Rank 4 and Rank 5 Xyz bosses, Beyond the Pendulum, and generic staples. Scale 3 and Scale 6 Dinomist Pendulums protect your other Dinomist cards from targeting and destruction while recycling themselves from the face-up Extra Deck.

summary.title: Starters & Scales
points: Dinomist Charge searches any Dinomist monster on activation, and once per turn when a Dinomist card goes from the field to the face-up Extra Deck it adds that card straight back to your hand.
Dinomists Howling places up to 2 Dinomist Pendulum Monsters directly from your Deck into your Pendulum Zones on activation, immediately setting up your Scale 3 and Scale 6 pair.

Dinomist Ceratops Special Summons itself from the hand while all monsters you control are Dinomist monsters, and Dinomist Brachion Special Summons itself when you do not control Brachion and the opponent controls the monster with the highest ATK.

summary.title: Opening: Dinomist Charge + Scale Setup
steps: Activate Dinomist Charge to search a missing Dinomist monster, then set a Scale 3 (Pteran, Ceratops, Spinos, or Stegosaur) and a Scale 6 (Rex, Brachion, Plesios, or Ankylos).

Special Summon Dinomist Brachion or Dinomist Ceratops and Link Summon Beyond the Pendulum to search another Dinomist Scale, then Pendulum Summon your Level 4 and Level 5 Dinomists from the hand and face-up Extra Deck.
When a Dinomist goes to the face-up Extra Deck, Dinomist Charge returns one to your hand, while two Level 5 Dinomists overlay into Cyber Dragon Nova and rank up into Cyber Dragon Infinity.

summary.title: Scale Protection & Battle Pressure
summary.text: Every Scale 3 Dinomist in the Pendulum Zone can destroy itself instead when another Dinomist card you control would be destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, while every Scale 6 Dinomist can destroy itself to negate an opponent's effect that targets another Dinomist card you control. On the field, Dinomist Plesios lowers opposing monsters' ATK and DEF by 100 per Dinomist card you control, Dinomist Pteran searches any Dinomist card when it destroys a monster by battle, Dinomist Ankylos banishes monsters destroyed by battle with your Dinomists, and Dinomic Powerload stops the opponent from activating cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Cyber Dragon Nova and Cyber Dragon Infinity are summoned off any two Level 5 Dinomists (Rex, Spinos, Brachion, or Ceratops); Infinity attaches an opponent's Attack Position monster as material and negates any card or effect once per turn.

Dinomist Rex Tributes another Dinomist after attacking to either attack a second time in a row with piercing or shuffle a card from the opponent's hand or field into the Deck without targeting, while Dinomist Spinos Tributes Dinomists to attack directly twice.
Dinomists Howling Tributes a Dinomist monster as a Quick Effect on either turn to bounce an opponent's card to the hand, which Dinomist Charge immediately refunds back to your hand.

Artifact Durendal, Tornado Dragon, Toadally Awesome, and I:P Masquerena provide flexible Rank 5, Rank 4, and Link disruption, while Dinomist Rush summons a Dinomist from the Deck unaffected by other cards' effects.

allow.Cyber Dragon Nova: Rank 5 Machine Xyz summoned using any two Level 5 Dinomist monsters to immediately rank up into Cyber Dragon Infinity.
allow.Cyber Dragon Infinity: Rank 6 Machine Xyz boss stacked over Cyber Dragon Nova that absorbs an opponent's Attack Position monster as material and provides once-per-turn omni-negation.
allow.Artifact Durendal: Rank 5 Machine Xyz made with two Level 5 Dinomists that changes an opposing effect into Spell/Trap destruction or refreshes hands.
allow.Tornado Dragon: Rank 4 Xyz that destroys a Spell or Trap on either turn.
allow.Beyond the Pendulum: Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches any Dinomist Pendulum Scale and pops 2 cards on the field after Pendulum Summoning.
allow.Toadally Awesome: Key WATER endboard omni-negate accessible via the deck's Level 2 or Rank 4 WATER monsters.

main: Dinomist Rex
Scale 6 Level 5 boss that tributes another Dinomist after attacking to either attack a second time in a row or shuffle 1 card from the opponent's hand/field into the Deck.
Dinomist Spinos
Scale 3 Level 5 OTK attacker that tributes another Dinomist to attack directly and/or make a second attack during each Battle Phase.
Dinomist Brachion
Scale 6 Level 5 extender that Special Summons itself from the hand if you do not control Dinomist Brachion and the opponent controls the monster with the highest ATK.
Dinomist Ceratops
Scale 3 Level 5 extender that Special Summons itself from the hand whenever all other monsters you control are Dinomist monsters (at least 1).
Dinomist Pteran
Scale 3 Level 4 searcher that adds any Dinomist card from your Deck to your hand whenever it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Dinomist Plesios
Scale 6 Level 4 debuffer that reduces the ATK and DEF of all monsters your opponent controls by 100 for each Dinomist card you control.
Dinomist Ankylos
Scale 6 Level 4 monster that banishes any monster destroyed by battle with a Dinomist monster you control.
Dinomist Stegosaur
Scale 3 Level 4 monster that destroys any battling monster after damage calculation when another Pendulum Monster you control battles.
Dinomist Charge
Core Continuous Spell that searches any Dinomist monster on activation AND adds a Dinomist card from your Extra Deck back to your hand once per turn when sent there from the field.
Dinomic Powerload
Archetypal Field Spell that boosts all Dinomists by 300 ATK/DEF and prevents the opponent from activating cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step when a Dinomist battles.
Dinomists Howling

Core Continuous Trap that places up to 2 Dinomist Pendulum Monsters directly from your Deck into your Pendulum Zones on activation, then tributes 1 Dinomist as a Quick Effect to bounce an opponent's card.
Dinomist Rush
Normal Trap that Special Summons 1 Dinomist monster from the Deck unaffected by other cards' effects.
extra: Rank 5 Machine Xyz made with two Level 5 Dinomists to rank up into Cyber Dragon Infinity.
Rank 6 Machine Xyz boss that attaches an opponent's monster and negates any card or effect.
Rank 5 Machine Xyz made with two Level 5 Dinomists that disrupts opposing plays.
Rank 4 Xyz that pops Spells/Traps on Quick Effect.
Link-2 Pendulum extender that searches a Dinomist Scale and pops 2 cards.
Rank 2: Quick Effect detaches an Aqua monster to negate and destroy an opponent's card or effect, and recycles WATER monsters.
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
